incident_summary: C2 beaconing from a compromised EC2 host.
root_cause: Unpatched web service exploited; attacker rotated C2 IPs.
actions_taken: Blocked C2 IP (ineffective - attacker rotated IPs)
outcome: Contained only after host isolation and credential reset.
lessons_learned: Blocking a single IP alone failed. Isolate the affected EC2 and force password resets in addition to IP blocking.
